Search results point to Jira, Shortcut, Plane, ClickUp, and Height as the main Linear alternatives, each suited to a different kind of team. The sources are mostly comparison or vendor content, and ClickUp's article is self-promotional, so check the pricing before deciding.

- **Jira:** Sources describe it as the pick for large engineering organizations that need deep customization. One notes that administrative overhead grows with custom workflows, apps, and larger teams.
- **Shortcut:** One comparison positions it as the closest swap if you want Linear's speed plus a roadmap and docs. Its integration library is thinner than Jira's or ClickUp's, and SSO sits on the paid Business tier (listed at $12/user/month).
- **Plane:** It is the open-source, self-hostable option. One source suggests self-hosting it for free if you need to own your data.
- **ClickUp:** It fits teams that need to bring in PMs, ops, and clients. One source says ClickUp has tons of integrations but some feel half-baked.
- **Height:** It is positioned as an AI-native tracker for smaller dev teams, and one source lists it as suited to teams of roughly 5 to 100 people.

On pricing and limits, one source says Linear is free under 250 issues and 2 teams, and most of these alternatives (Shortcut, Jira, ClickUp) are free under 10 users. Shortcut's and Jira's paid prices are roughly consistent across sources, but I found no current official pricing page to confirm them, so verify before relying on these numbers.

content.text:
Linear's main competitors are Jira, Shortcut, Plane, ClickUp and Height. The comparison pages I found are mostly vendor or affiliate content, so treat the details as indicative. I didn't check any official pricing pages.

| Tool | Best for | Trade-offs |
|---|---|---|
| **Jira** | Large engineering orgs that need deep customization | Admin overhead grows with custom workflows, apps and team size |
| **Shortcut** | The closest swap if you want Linear's speed plus roadmaps and docs | Fewer integrations than Jira or ClickUp; SSO is on the paid Business tier (listed at about $12/user/month) |
| **Plane** | Open-source and self-hostable, so you own your data | One source suggests self-hosting it for free; I didn't verify its feature parity |
| **ClickUp** | Mixed teams that include PMs, ops and clients | Many integrations, but some feel half-baked |
| **Height** | AI-native tracking for small dev teams (listed at roughly 5–100 people) | Aimed at smaller teams |

One source says Linear's free tier covers up to 250 issues and 2 teams. It also says Shortcut, Jira and ClickUp are free under 10 users.
